body.prose:
A store is where holons are kept and how they travel: every version of every holon, and every commit that changed them, as objects that never change, with one pointer saying which commit is current. A store can be copied, served and attached anywhere, and every copy is whole.

*The store as a primitive the author's, 2026-11-01; its shape proposed by the session and agreed by the author, given whole in [the store](ref:01M6F8G0M0FGNZ607SJXS1QANP).*

A store is one space, and any whole within it can be taken away as a store of its own. And it is one source among the engine's integrations, the native one: git, the browser's history or a video's data are sources too, each with its own truth and format, reached through programs.

*The author's, 2026-11-04, told in [the store](ref:01M6M9PESE307QYKEJVMRS5T8J).*
body.title: Store
